question: Find a paper supporting an experimentally demonstrated method to improve SnO2-based n-i-p perovskite solar-cell performance. Verify that the paper actually studies an n-i-p SnO2 device before using it as evidence.
final_answer:
Based on the Perovskite Database (pdb), several experimental n-i-p perovskite solar cells utilizing $\text{SnO}_2$ as an electron transport layer are documented, including devices associated with DOI `10.1038/s41586-021-03285-w` (which achieves a PCE of 25.2%) and DOI `10.1039/d0ta04721j`. 

However, the literature agent was unable to extract and verify verbatim text quotes confirming the specific experimental modification methods and device architecture details directly from the papers due to retrieval limitations (returning INCOMPLETE status for the required text evidence). Therefore, while database records confirm the existence of these $\text{SnO}_2$-based n-i-p devices, specific verbatim textual quotes supporting the improvement method from the literature could not be established.
